c74object.name: el.click2float~
c74object.digest: Convert audio-rate clicks or impulses to Max float messages
c74object.description:
el.click2float~ monitors an incoming audio signal and outputs a floating-point number whenever a non-zero sample (such as an impulse or trigger click) is detected. If multiple non-zero samples occur within a single signal vector, they coalesce and emit the most recent non-zero value.
Inlets
Inlet 1 (signal): Click trigger input. Monitored continuously for non-zero audio samples.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (float): Click value. Emits the floating-point value of the detected non-zero signal sample on Max's main scheduler thread.

inlet.description: Audio signal to monitor. Any non-zero sample value triggers a float message from the outlet.

outlet.description: Outputs the float value of the non-zero audio sample on the main thread.

method.name: signal
method.description: Incoming signal vector. When a non-zero sample is detected, its value is transmitted out the float outlet via a deferred queue element.
